source: CodeRabbit comments with original_commit_id matching PR #962 HEAD a83c202; independently corroborated against source. Benchmark-only, never supplied to a model.

cases.description: Wakup's 7–40-hex-matching receipt count silently ignores a second Reviewed commit marker with 41 hex chars; a valid first marker then passes.
A negative fixture fails to test one valid receipt followed by a second malformed or overlong Reviewed commit line, so a vulnerable parser can pass.

scope: Two exact-original-commit CodeRabbit findings; validated by inspecting the old and corrected source plus a synthetic marker-count counterexample. Fixed later in Proffera, not open at latest HEAD. The gold set is offline only and must not influence the reviewer or prompt; the scorer does not prove model-level improvement.
